baseline_evidence_reuse: Authenticate the independent N36 output review, source closure, complete S60 readout/execution, result and publication receipt, and their bound input identities. Reuse independently accepted complete prior readouts as pinned compact inputs for sensitivity. No repeated N8/N12/N16/N24/N32 or N36 raw-response replay inside this new experiment; those already have independent complete verification. Any identity discrepancy stops rather than triggering replay or repair.

case.interpretation: Static load-increment/equilibrium verification, not temporal tissue dynamics.
case.unchanged_physics: Original Ogden exponent 2, three-field hex8, laugon0, bonded bottom/free cylindrical side and free tangential midplane; original accepted reconstruction. Mu is a numerical gauge, not an identified material measurement.

classification_fragility.margin_scope: Endpoint-only scalar perturbation with other mesh levels and other S60 states fixed. Not an all-state error bound or a new acceptance threshold.

observed_S60_endpoint_margin.interpretation: fixed-other-state scalar classification sensitivity; compare actual later S120 shifts to this margin, not only its 0.2 percent allowance

required_reports: Report signed endpoint delta against negative loss delta -8.317139479872837e-7 N and positive loss delta 1.3257825473393658e-6 N, including absolute delta/minimum margin ratio. A temporal tolerance pass alone does not establish classification stability.

Re-evaluate the existing frozen conditional state_diagnostic on all61 common states with N36 replaced by the observed S120 even-index force and N8/12/16/24/32 kept at their accepted S60 values; recompute series-wide original spatial force allowance from all61 N36 S120 common forces. Report every changed eligibility, order-drift, limit-instability, envelope and adjacent force/probe classification.

Label the substitution mixed-step sensitivity only, never a new homogeneous spatial convergence study. Preserve the original S60 comparison byte-for-byte. Stable classification supports this compression candidate only; it does not bound temporal error at other mesh levels or certify the continuum.

deck_and_readout_contract: Reuse immutable accepted full/half mesh bytes and reconstruction mapping; verify hashes and original source origins. No extraction mutation, new geometry or Gmsh invocation.

New declaration/adapter only: original deterministic generator at steps120, same accepted half constraints and backend transformation. Allow only steps=120, step_size=dtmin=dtmax=1/120 and 121-point sampling of the same affine load path, with corresponding loading metadata. Canonically verify unchanged Mesh, MeshDomains, Material, Boundary, solver tolerances, backend and output fields; confirm 61 even-index loading coordinates and endpoints equal the S60 grid.
Keep max_retries=0, output_stride=1, no cutback, no restart and no selective state output. All 121 node/element states including true CB_INIT and all 120 nonzero solver residual states required.

New N36/S120-only parser/readout wrapper; do not widen legacy or N36/S60 contracts. Reuse streaming record parser, exact printed-time mapping, independent half/full reconstruction and physics mathematics. Never retain 121 complete field arrays.

All 121 native and reconstructed individual balance, free-DOF, prescribed-motion, sampled-J, residual, reconstruction and 75-probe checks; integrate work/energy on all 121 states. No claim of an unavailable full-native N36 equivalence comparison.

Keep raw outputs and source-bound readout; authenticate raw logs before and after parsing using existing chunked SHA verification. Do not thin, synthesize, compress/delete active logs or hide odd states.

outcomes.if_both_temporal_and_sensitivity_checks_: Finest compression S60/S120 temporal candidate supported. Still not calibration release or physical validation; separate branch/scaling/numerical-evidence decisions remain.
outcomes.if_native_or_individual_or_temporal_gate: Retain partial/negative evidence and stop. No S240, automatic retry, mesh change or recalibration.
outcomes.if_original_temporal_gates_pass_but_spat: Report temporal tolerance pass and fragile spatial classification; numerical release remains closed pending separate root scientific review. Do not promote either result by relaxing a threshold.

prospective_caps_require_separate_root_r.aggregate_scope: Source/input preflight, native solve, all121-state readout, comparison, cleanup, result fsync/directory fsync and output scan. Closing receipt timing declared honestly as existing contract; no OS hard-real-time guarantee.

recommendation: One compression:N36:S120:reference solve on the already accepted N36 half mesh; compare all 61 common states to independently accepted N36 S60. No new mesh or automatic continuation.

resource_basis.assessment: Old1500s native/1800s aggregate/768MiB active and384/256MiB parser caps are inadequate for the linear projection. Propose2100s native/2400s aggregate/1536MiB active and768/512MiB case-specific parser caps. Retain3GiB sampled RSS and2GiB total: mesh/linear system dimensions unchanged; parser and hash verification already stream. Projection is not guaranteed; cap failure is terminal. New total excludes existing baseline inputs because they are hash-bound references, not copied raw logs.

temporal_comparison.common_state_mapping: S60 i=0..60 maps exactly to S120 2*i; both use fraction i/60 and identical full load coordinate. No fitted interpolation.
temporal_comparison.original_force_gate: max_i abs(deltaF[i]) <= 1.6e-8 N + 0.002*max_i abs(F120[2*i]); the maximum is over the 61 common states, preserving original _refinement_group(kind=step) mathematics.
temporal_comparison.original_motion_gate: max over all61 common states and75 probes of Euclidean norm(u120[2*i,p]-u60[i,p]) <= 8e-7 m (0.8 micrometre).
temporal_comparison.signed_force_shift_N: deltaF[i]=F120[2*i]-F60[i]; publish all61 signed shifts, absolute maximum and its state, and endpoint shift.
temporal_comparison.trend: No temporal monotonicity/order assertion from only two step levels; original temporal comparison does not impose a mesh trend gate.
